skills.name: Daruma Strike (ダルマ出撃)
skills.line: Your fortune will be everlasting when you're with friends and family.
skills.description: SP Zashiki Warashi commands a daruma to attack a single target, dealing damage equal to 100% of her ATK. ;Parade Lover (福运/福運) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 75 stacks. Each time she gains 15 stacks, and if she is not inflicted with a control effect and an effect such as Banish, she immediately uses Fun Gacha which grants 1 random Basic R effect that hasn't been triggered yet. Using Fun Gacha at max stacks clears all stacks.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 125% and grants her 2 Parade Lover stacks.

skills.name: Fortune Accumulated (福運蓄積/福運貯め)
skills.line: Don't worry, the fortune you missed will come back to you when accumulated...
skills.description:
Exclusive effect.
What's your gacha luck today? Whenever another ally uses 1 onibi, SP Zashiki Warashi is granted 1 Parade Lover stack. ;Parade Lover (福运/福運) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 75 stacks. Each time she gains 15 stacks, and if she is not inflicted with a control effect and an effect such as Banish, she immediately uses Fun Gacha which grants 1 random Basic R effect that hasn't been triggered yet. Using Fun Gacha at max stacks clears all stacks.

upgrades.text: Triggers EXP Daruma first if her initial RES is higher than 50%; otherwise, triggers Base Daruma first.
Unlocks Fun Gacha's SR effect: Skill Daruma.
Unlocks Fun Gacha's SSR effect: The Fortunebringer.
Guaranteed to trigger The Fortunebringer when using Fun Gacha at max stacks.

skills.name: Fun Gacha: Base Daruma (子供ガチャ・招福ダルマ)
skills.description: Basic R effect. Increases all allies damage reduction by 30%, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Fun Gacha: Grade Daruma (子供ガチャ・奉為ダルマ)
skills.description: Basic R effect. Increases all allies damage dealt and damage reduction by 15%, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Fun Gacha: EXP Daruma (子供ガチャ・大吉ダルマ)
skills.description: Basic R effect. Increases all allies RES by 60% of her initial RES, lasts for 2 turns. If an ally resists an effect, increases their move bar by 30% (only once).

skills.name: Fun Gacha: Skill Daruma (子供ガチャ・御行ダルマ)
skills.description: Rare SR effect with a 9% probability rate. Grants all the Basic R effects and increases all allies damage dealt by 30%, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Fun Gacha: Lucky Daruma (子供ガチャ・福運ダルマ)
skills.description: Super Rare SSR effect with a 1% probability rate. Immediately grants the Rare SR effect and has a 100% base chance of inflicting Morph on all enemies, lasts for 2 turns.

skills.name: Purging Orb (魂火除厄/魂火厄祓)
skills.line: May all reap what they sow.
skills.description:
SP Zashiki Warashi spends additional onibi (up to 3), each onibi spent grants her 2 Parade Lover stacks.
She grants Fortune Shelter to all allies, sustained for 1 turn. At the end of turn, and if she is not inflicted with a control effect or an effect such as Banish, immediately uses Fun Gacha. ;Parade Lover (福运/福運) : :'''General, Mark''': Max of 75 stacks. Each time she gains 15 stacks, and if she is not inflicted with a control effect and an effect such as Banish, she immediately uses Fun Gacha which grants 1 random Basic R effect that hasn't been triggered yet. Using Fun Gacha at max stacks clears all stacks. ;Fortune Shelter (福運・守) : :'''Buff, Mark''': Consumed when damage received exceeds 30% of own max HP to reduce the damage by 25%.

upgrades.text: When Fortune Shelter on an ally is consumed, increases their move bar by 30%.
Grants 3 onibi when using Fun Gacha.

bio.condition: Increase SP Zashiki Warashi's level to 40.
Increase SP Zashiki Warashi's skills 8 times.
In PVN zones, trigger Fun Gacha: The Fortunegiver and win.
